ftbguides.client_settings.general.gui_sc:
Custom GUI scale while the guidebook is open
This may be clamped, based on your current screen resolution
A value of 0 means to use default Minecraft GUI scaling
Adjustable in the GUI with =/- keys, or Ctrl + Mouse Wheel
ftbguides.client_settings.general.home.t: Pressing Alt+Home goes to this guide page
ftbguides.client_settings.general.search: Searching only looks for pages in the same guide namespace as the current page
